name: Pew
description: A cathedral in your pocket: the great ideas, prayer, music, art and poetry of the Christian tradition, and a church near you, in a few minutes a day.

analytics.note: Set plausible to the site's domain in Plausible (or a compatible, cookie-free host and its script in src) to count three things: Morning kept, Returned after a week, First church visit. Empty: no analytics at all.
